review_scope: Atlas API/cache identity, full semantic views, overflow splitting, component aggregation and offline checkpoint replay

findings.issue: Split fragments lost original callable identity in call context
findings.resolution: Call catalog is now built from original complete AST callables before splitting; component provenance retains origin_symbol

findings.issue: Second-pass/class-wrapping context could reject feasible semantic splits
findings.resolution: All repeated call/class context is budgeted before a single recursive AST splitting pass; fragments retain original AST and enclosing structure

findings.issue: Standalone corpus producer/Atlas consumer default paths differed
findings.resolution: Ready full-view corpus defaults to corpus_atlas; draft/legacy defaults are isolated; explicit defaults preparation also uses corpus_atlas

limitations: Selected syntactic call relations do not resolve all dynamic aliases/imports
Unsplit atomic expressions or shared initialization that itself exceeds context require manual semantic source selection
No paid API request, real external vectors, training result or performance claim was produced
